snippet.title: Pro Yakyuu Spirits 2014 (PS3) - Gameplay
snippet.description:
Game: Pro Yakyuu Spirits 2014
Platform: PlayStation 3
Release Year: 2014

A full game of Prospi 2014 for the PS3. Featuring a 19-year-old Shohei Ohtani on the mound for the Fighters, taking on the Marines. 

***
You can also check out my website about baseball video games at https://30-30.club.
